name: Purchase Order Report - Detail
query:
SELECT
    po.name AS 'PO No.',
    po.custom_order_by AS 'Order By',
    po.status AS 'Status',
    po.supplier_name AS 'Supplier Name',
    DATE_FORMAT(po.transaction_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'Date',
    po.currency AS 'Ccy',
    
    CONCAT_WS(' / ', poi.item_code, poi.item_name, i.brand) AS 'Item Code / Item Name / Brand:Data:250',
    
    poi.uom AS 'UOM',
    poi.qty AS 'Order:Float:',
    poi.received_qty AS 'Received:Float:',
    poi.returned_qty AS 'Returned:Float:',
    poi.rate AS 'Price:Currency/ccy:',
    po.total AS 'Total:Currency/ccy:',
    po.grand_total AS 'Grand Total:Currency/ccy:'
FROM
    `tabPurchase Order` AS po
LEFT JOIN
    `tabPurchase Order Item` AS poi ON poi.parent = po.name
-- TAMBAHAN JOIN: Untuk mengambil data Brand dari Doctype Item
LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem` AS i ON i.name = poi.item_code
WHERE
    po.transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY
    po.name ASC;
